The [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]], [[Hydra (Grand Inquisitor)|Hydra]], in her early life, lived on her homeworld with her silent and savage [[Hydra's uncle|uncle]].<ref name="Reckoning">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Reckoning]]''</ref>

== Behind the scenes ==
Hydra's homeworld was first mentioned in the [[2008]] young reader's [[List of novels by release date|novel]] ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Reckoning]]''. Reckoning does not make it clear if Hydra is of a native species to the planet or a native of it at all.<ref name="Reckoning" /> Additionally, her species isn't even defined as in ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon|Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'' Hydra is established as humanoid,<ref name="Secret Weapon">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]''</ref> but, [[The Essential Reader's Companion|the Essential Reader's Companion]] later claims she is human.<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> 

Reckoning makes mention of Hydra herding animals on the planet, but what the animals in specific are unknown.<ref name="Reckoning" />
